about.title: About
about.description: Who keeps this archive, and why it exists.
about.keeper.title: Who keeps this site
about.keeper.lede: Endoretic is kept by an ordinary Chinese blogger who loves Japanese animation, novels, electronic music, and rhythm games.
about.interests.title: Interests
about.origin.title: Why I began recording
about.origin.statement: Some of the things I love are moving farther away in time.
about.origin.body: More capable AI agents suddenly made building a personal site feel possible. At the same time, I began to notice that parts of the culture I care about were receding into the past. There is some irony in using a new technology to preserve the memory of an older future; that tension became part of the reason to begin.
about.fragments.label: What that includes
about.fragments.body: Turn-of-the-century Japanese science fiction imagining digital futures with equal parts wonder and melancholy; animation and novels rooted in an increasingly distant period; rhythm games shaped by an earlier internet and its ways of listening...they might not have a second opportunity on earth.
about.purpose.title: Why a personal site
about.purpose.body: A personal site gives finished tools, notes, and unfinished work one durable address under my control. It can preserve their context instead of scattering it across platforms, and it should remain readable years from now.

credits.title: Credits
credits.description: Every published media file is self-hosted and connected to its original source, license, attribution, and recorded modifications.
credits.field.creator: Creator / institution
credits.software.title: Software
credits.software.body: The site is built with Astro and TypeScript. Exact dependency versions are recorded in the package lockfile.
credits.typeface.title: Typeface
credits.typeface.body: The Hymmnos display layer renders ordinary Latin letters through a fan-made Hymmnos font, self-hosted here as a WOFF2 conversion of the TrueType original. The font states no licence terms; it is served only when a reader opens the language layer, and the site remains complete without it.
credits.homage.title: For the maker of this language
credits.homage.body: This layer exists out of admiration for Hymmnos, the language of emotion created by Akira Tsuchiya for the Ar tonelico series. Respect and thanks for imagining a language that carries feeling in its grammar rather than leaving it to tone of voice.
credits.homage.note: endoretic.cc is an unofficial, non-commercial personal site. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Gust Co., Ltd. or Koei Tecmo Games Co., Ltd. Hymmnos and Ar tonelico remain the property of their creators and rights holders.
